taxonomic_history.name: Dryocoetes apatoides
taxonomic_history.note: Johnson et al. (2026) lists this name as a synonym of Hypothenemus tristis, although the same checklist also recognizes Dryocoetiops apatoides (Eichhoff, 1876) as a separate accepted species. This conflicting source assertion is retained for provenance and is not adopted as current synonymy in the present synthesis.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus tristis (Eichhoff, 1876), VSN_3356. Johnson et al. (2026) lists Dryocoetes apatoides Eichhoff, 1876 as a synonym of H. tristis, but the same checklist also recognizes Dryocoetiops apatoides (Eichhoff, 1876) as a separate accepted species. This internally conflicting treatment is retained in the source-level taxonomic history for provenance, but Dryocoetes apatoides is not adopted as a current synonym of H. tristis in the present synthesis. Beaver & Liu (2010) treated Hypothenemus taihokuensis (Schedl) as the accepted name and synonymized H. cosmoderoides under it; that historical treatment is likewise retained at the source layer.
